method: Table values copied from the datasheet text with a fetch tool (no curve digitized). FBSOA Figs. 13/14 (T_C = 25/75 C; 25 us ... 100 ms, DC lines) and the Z_thJC Fig. 15 are graph-only and were not read. Check: 75 C + 325 W x 0.23 C/W = 149.8 C = T_JM.
